Lists NICE, CADTH, PBAC, IQWiG/G-BA, HAS, ICER, HTAIn as named agencies with brief role description each
Agency-note callout on EU Joint Clinical Assessment (EU HTA Regulation, in force Jan 2025 for oncology/ATMPs) decoupling joint clinical assessment from still-national economic assessment
HTAIn described: housed under Dept of Health Research, MoHFW; issues Indian reference case; informs Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY technology decisions
Describes 5-stage product lifecycle: early pipeline, Phase III/pre-launch, launch/HTA submission, post-launch RWE, re-assessment/LOE

Why-R case: reproducibility via renv+Git, statistical depth (flexsurv/meta/metafor/netmeta/brms/MatchIt/WeightIt), cost vs TreeAge/SAS licensing, reviewer transparency, Quarto/R Markdown reporting interoperability; also states R is not strictly superior (TreeAge for non-coders, SAS institutional entrenchment, Python for ML)
HEOR-in-practice callout: NICE DSU R-based worked examples for survival extrapolation (TSD 21), published STA appraisals using R-built models
Maps the book's 8 parts onto the general HEOR workflow stages, narrative chapter with no R code (expected for an intro chapter)
